name: The Hourglass
flavour: The Hourglass turns. What you hand out lingers.
text: The sand runs slow for them: your burns, poison, slows, marks and pins last 15% longer a level.
art_prompt: a thick roll of shiny silver-grey duct tape seen at a slight angle, a torn strip of tape curling off it

A.note: the icon before the cards (passes 47-72): an object, not a card

B.note: B · tilted card (detail: the least: flat colours, one symbol, nothing else)

recipe.subject: One single fortune-teller tarot card standing upright and tilted about 12 degrees clockwise, filling the picture from top to bottom, seen straight on. The card has a thick cream parchment border with rounded corners and a thin dark brown line just inside it and a deep purple face. One huge bold symbol fills almost the whole face: one big golden hourglass with glowing golden sand falling through it, a small crescent moon beside it, in gold, purple and black. The symbol is so big it overlaps the border a little. Nothing else on the card: no stars, no landscape, no corner ornaments, no frame lines inside
recipe.style: Mobile game item icon in the cel-shaded anime style of an action RPG mobile game: crisp confident black line art, a thick clean black outline round the whole silhouette, flat colours with two-tone cel shadows and one sharp highlight, simple chunky shapes, only two or three bold saturated colours plus black and the card's border, high contrast, readable at thumbnail size, centred and filling the frame with a small margin. E.note: E · gloved hand (detail: the most: a lace glove, engraved hatching, a tiny desert horizon)

The card has a thick cream parchment border with rounded corners and a thin dark brown line just inside it and a deep purple face showing one big bold symbol: one big golden hourglass with glowing golden sand falling through it, a small crescent moon beside it, in gold, purple and black, with fine engraved hatching in its shadows and a tiny desert horizon of cactus silhouettes along the bottom of the card's face.
